changes.title: Trailblazing Feminist and Social Activist Gloria Steinem Dies at 92
changes.summary: Gloria Steinem, the pioneering feminist and journalist whose activism revolutionized the personal and professional lives of women has died at 92. Steinem dedicated her life to causes ranging from reproductive freedom and domestic violence prevention to workplace gender inequalities. NBC’s Anne Thompson looks back on he.

changes.title: Dems demand DHS fund election security. And, journalist Gloria Steinem has died
changes.summary: Two Democrats are demanding that Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of the midterms. And, trail-blazing journalist Gloria Steinem has died. (Image credit: Mario Tama).

changes.title: Gloria Steinem’s Glamour Was a Means to an End
changes.summary: The glasses, the hairdo, the bell bottoms and hip-slung belts were all wrapped up in her feminist cause.

changes.title: Gloria Steinem, Personification of the Feminist Movement, Dies at 92
changes.summary: She challenged sexist assumptions, helping women develop a sense of self-worth and gain a measure of equality at work, at home and in society at large.

changes.title: Gloria Steinem's Long and Revealing History With TIME
changes.summary: Over the course of her long and influential life, Gloria Steinem went from being described in the pages of TIME as “one of the best dates to take to a New York party these days” and “smashing looking Gucci liberal” to being lauded as a “ feminist icon .” If nothing else, the shift in the tone of her coverage in the mag.
